name: web-design-studio
description: Design and refine editable websites with an AI-aware visual canvas.

interface.longDescription: An AI-first visual website design workbench where AI generates and revises a shared structured document while people fine-tune the canvas and leave component-level requests. Build with native primitives, searchable production component systems, responsive sections, reusable instances, precise annotations, and optional HTML, React, or Vue export.
defaultPrompt: Create an editable landing page for my product.
Apply the pending component notes to this design.
Improve the selected section while preserving the rest.
